eventos.aviso: Alert: A planet-encircling dust storm is approaching. In 2018, one grew to cover all of Mars in three weeks.
eventos.dato: Atmospheric dust blocks sunlight. In NASA studies at Jezero Crater, solar power dropped from ~34 kW to ~11 kW during major dust storms.

que_habria_pasado.normal: Your solar panels would have lost nearly two-thirds of their electrical output.
que_habria_pasado.mejorado: Your Kilopower nuclear reactor maintained full output, completely independent of sunlight.

eventos.aviso: Orbital alert: Coronal mass ejection arriving. Immediate action required: activate storm shelter shielding.
eventos.dato: In September 2017, a severe solar storm doubled Martian surface radiation levels for two days. Mars lacks a global intrinsic magnetic field for protection.

que_habria_pasado.normal: A standard habitat shell would have allowed dangerous ionizing radiation to penetrate.
que_habria_pasado.mejorado: Your composite regolith and water shielding effectively attenuated the vast majority of incoming radiation.

normal.aviso: Good news: Surface gusts are scouring dust deposits off your solar panel arrays.
normal.dato: Martian winds periodically cleaned the solar panels of rovers Spirit and Opportunity, boosting power by up to 10% and extending their missions by years.

mejorado.aviso: High winds detected outside, but your nuclear reactor operates undisturbed.
mejorado.dato: Solar arrays depend on wind gusts for passive cleaning. A nuclear reactor operates continuously regardless of weather.

que_habria_pasado.normal: Atmospheric winds cleaned your solar panels, granting a temporary energy surplus.
que_habria_pasado.mejorado: With your nuclear reactor operational, surface winds had no effect on power output.

eventos.aviso: The Sun is positioned between Mars and Earth. All direct interplanetary communications are severed.
eventos.dato: Solar conjunction occurs every 26 months and lasts approximately two weeks. During this blackout, the Martian crew must operate fully autonomously.

que_habria_pasado.normal: Without fresh crops, complete isolation from Earth severely impacted crew morale.
que_habria_pasado.mejorado: Tending fresh hydroponic crops provided therapeutic sensory stimulation, preserving crew morale.

normal.aviso: After consecutive sols of identical prepackaged rations, crew appetite and morale are declining.
normal.dato: On long-duration space missions, repetitive diets induce psychological appetite fatigue. NASA grows fresh salad crops on the ISS partly to mitigate this.

mejorado.aviso: Alert in growth chambers: Fungal mold detected on hydroponic plant leaves.
mejorado.dato: In 2016, zinnia plants on the ISS suffered fungal mold from excess humidity. Forced fan ventilation dried them out rapidly: solving one microgravity hazard can trigger another.

que_habria_pasado.normal: Relying exclusively on shelf-stable rations led to psychological menu fatigue.
que_habria_pasado.mejorado: Hydroponic farming required precise humidity and airflow balancing to prevent crop blight.

eventos.aviso: Warning: Mineral precipitation is obstructing the primary water reclamation loop.
eventos.dato: Urine processors aboard the ISS are limited by calcium sulfate precipitation. Adding a dedicated Brine Processor Assembly pushes total closed-loop recovery to 98%.

que_habria_pasado.normal: Operating at standard 93-94% recovery resulted in substantial water inventory depletion.
que_habria_pasado.mejorado: With your 98% brine processor active, water loss was minimal and quickly stabilized.

eventos.aviso: Critical: Carbon dioxide concentrations are rising inside the pressurized habitat.
eventos.dato: On the ISS, amine scrubbers remove CO₂, an oxygen generator electrolyzes water, and a Sabatier reactor recycles CO₂ with H₂ to recover ~50% of oxygen.

que_habria_pasado.normal: A standard ISS-style ECLSS would have suffered steep oxygen depletion.
que_habria_pasado.mejorado: Your advanced MOXIE system compensated reliably, drawing a small auxiliary energy surge.

eventos.aviso: Fine abrasive regolith dust breached the airlock seal during EVA ingress. Decontaminate immediately.
eventos.dato: Martian soil contains 0.5% to 1.0% toxic perchlorate salts hazardous to human thyroid function, along with microscopic abrasive basalt particles.

que_habria_pasado.normal: A basic airlock seal allowed abrasive toxic dust to penetrate deeper into living quarters.
que_habria_pasado.mejorado: Your multi-stage decontamination airlock effectively confined and purged the particulate breach.
